paragraphs.source_en: One additional note: In some companies, there is so much in terms of industry and domain knowledge that the product manager may be supplemented with what are called domain experts or subject matter experts. Examples of domain experts can be found in companies that build tax software or create medical devices. In these cases, you can’t expect the product managers to have the necessary level of k domain depth, in addition to everything else. But these cases are fairly k rare. The normal case is that the product manager does need to have (or be able to learn) the necessary domain expertise.
